subject: Post-call: Compliance sprint readout & evidence next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Torres <michael.torres@finedge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-04T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Compliance sprint readout & evidence next steps

Hi Michael / Aisha —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can align on the evidence path for FinEdge's procurement review. If I missed anything, flag it and I’ll update.

High-level goals you shared:
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (in-scope for access control, change management, logging, and incident response).
- Audit log availability for transaction and admin events; retention policy target is 7 years for transaction metadata, 3 years for detailed debug logs (your compliance team to confirm).
- DPA and data residency guarantee for US-only storage.
- Pen test report (you want vendor-agnostic scope and remediation timeline).

Key pain points:
- Need an artifact mapping (what Redwood can provide immediately vs. what requires Private deployment).
- Concern about long-term retention and exportability of logs for regulator requests.
- Clarity on SLAs for log export / snapshot delivery during audits.

What Redwood will provide (attached):
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf — one-page SOC 2 readiness summary (what our hosted offering covers vs. Dedicated/Private).
- retention-matrix.xlsx — proposed mapping of artifacts to retention options and export formats.
- pen-test-scope-template.docx — vendor-agnostic scope we use with customers when coordinating engagements.

Immediate asks for FinEdge:
1) Confirm the final retention requirement for transaction-level data (7 years vs. 10 years).
2) Share the compliance contact(s) who will own artifact intake (I think Aisha will be primary).
3) Provide the procurement timeline (you mentioned a PO target in October).

Suggested timeline / next steps:
- Internal review: Redwood (Neha) will review your answers and mark which artifacts are available from hosted environment vs require Private deployment (target: by 2027-10-08).
- Follow-up sync: 30 minutes on 2027-10-12 to review artifact list and procurement gating items (please confirm availability).
- Deliverables: updated artifact intake sheet + sample SLA snippet by 2027-10-11.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf), retention-matrix.xlsx (xlsx), pen-test-scope-template.docx (docx)

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping the intake quickly.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Michael Torres <michael.torres@finedge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@finedge.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Compliance sprint readout & evidence next steps

Jonas — thanks for the concise recap and the attachments. A couple of clarifying items from our side before the follow-up: 

1) Does Redwood support an on-prem / VPC Private deployment that can retain raw transaction logs for longer than the hosted offering? If so, what is the export format and how do you handle long-term archival (S3/azure blob link or stored by customer)?

2) Can you provide a short SLA snippet (availability + access to audit logs) that we can share with our legal team? We don’t need the full contract yet, just the extract that addresses log availability and response time for audit export requests.

3) IP allowlisting: is that supported for API endpoints in hosted mode or only in Dedicated/Private? We have internal policies that require IP whitelisting for third-party endpoints.

Procurement is on a tight cadence — aiming to finalize vendor shortlist by Oct 20. Aisha will coordinate the intake of artifacts.

—Michael
Michael Torres
Head of Compliance | FinEdge
michael.torres@finedge.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Torres <michael.torres@finedge.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@finedge.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Compliance sprint readout & evidence next steps

Michael / Aisha — great questions, answers below and next steps at the bottom.

1) Private deployment & long-term retention
- Yes: Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem option) supports customer-managed archival for raw transaction logs. We surface exports in JSON and CSV; for large retention windows we typically recommend customer-managed object storage (S3-compatible) where we push periodic encrypted snapshots.
- Hosted: we provide audit log exports for 90/365-day windows; data beyond that moves to our cold archive (customers can request full export). For regulatory-level retention (7+ years) we generally recommend Private + object storage.

2) SLA snippet
- Attached is a short sample SLA extract that covers: log export request response (48 hours for export-ready package), log availability for API queries (99.9% platform availability for hosted endpoints; higher for Dedicated with committed capacity), and support escalation windows.
- Note: final SLA terms vary by contract / Dedicated capacity commitments — we can provide a tailored snippet for procurement to review.

3) IP allowlisting
- Supported for Dedicated and Private. For hosted API we support token scoping and network-level restrictions via customer-managed proxies; direct IP allowlisting on our hosted public endpoints is not enabled (we can provide ingress through a Private connection or marketplace integration to satisfy the rule).

Action items (assigned):
- FinEdge: confirm final retention window for transaction-level data and compliance contact(s) (Aisha to confirm). (FinEdge)
- Redwood: Neha to validate which artifacts in retention-matrix.xlsx we can deliver from hosted vs require Private (due 2027-10-08). (Neha)
- Redwood: Deliver SLA extract and flagged artifact list (due 2027-10-11). (Jonas / Priyom)
- Schedule: propose 2027-10-12 10:00 PT for a 30-minute touch — please confirm or suggest alternatives.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf), retention-matrix.xlsx (xlsx), pen-test-scope-template.docx (docx), redwood-sla-snippet.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — I’ll hold the follow-up invite pending your confirmation of the time.

Best regards,
Jonas
